prompt: A rectangular prism has dimensions $4$ by $5$ by $6$. What is its volume?
hint: Volume of a rectangular prism is length times width times height.

hints.text: Volume of a rectangular prism is length times width times height.

learningObjective: Compute the volume of a rectangular prism.
explanation: Equivalently: one layer holds $4 \times 5 = 20$ unit cubes, and there are $6$ layers.
The order of multiplication does not matter.

alternativeExplanations.title: Volume versus surface area
steps: Volume is what fits inside, measured in cubic units.
Surface area is the wrapping, measured in square units — here it would be $2(20 + 24 + 30) = 148$.
The units in the answer choices often tell you which one is wanted, so read them.
